name: boss-pre-setup
description:
STEP ONE OF TWO - this gets your computer ready. It does NOT install your operating system; it hands off to that at the end.

To activate, type in this command: set up my computer

What it does: sets up what your Claude is allowed to do on this computer so it stops asking you about every step; checks what is already installed; puts Git and the GitHub tool in place without ever needing your computer password; walks you through the one sign-in only you can do; confirms you can reach your system; brings it down onto your machine; then starts the system's own setup, which does the personalizing.

You will never be asked to open a terminal or type a command. Takes about 15-20 minutes.
